requirements.title: Project must have .fusa.json configuration
Project must have a Java build file
Project must have a LICENSE file
Project must have a README
Project must have CI configuration
Engine must run all registered rules
Engine must isolate rule failures so one rule does not prevent others from running
Engine must distinguish ERROR, WARNING, INFO severity
Engine must honour rule exclusions from config
Engine must support filtered rule runs
Statement coverage must meet configured threshold
Trace must support parent_id on requirements to model HLR/LLR hierarchy
Trace must validate HLR/LLR hierarchy: orphan LLRs and childless HLRs are violations
Qualify must support qualification_method, qualifier_identity, and qualification_record_uri fields
Qualify must support V&V independence fields and compute independence status
Coverage must support MC/DC analysis from LLVM coverage JSON export
Tool qualification report (qualify-report.json) must be present
Test evidence bundle (.fusa-evidence.json) must be present
All annotated requirements must have at least one //fusa:test reference
Trace must support --func-coverage N gating on percentage of public functions carrying a //fusa:req tag
Trace must flag //fusa:test tags whose id is not registered in .fusa-reqs.json as a dangling reference (check WARNING, rule TRACE002)
Trace.buildMatrix() must aggregate scanned annotations into a per-requirement traceability matrix
Engine registry mustRegister() must wrap registration failures in IllegalStateException
Engine registry register() must reject null rules and duplicate rule ids
Engine.run() must execute all registered rules with no filter (default entry point)
Detect returning null from non-void methods without //fusa:unsafe
System.exit() calls must be annotated //fusa:safe-state
Raw Thread creation must be flagged unless annotated //fusa:unsafe
Static mutable fields require //fusa:shared annotation
Floating-point equality comparison must be flagged unless annotated //fusa:unsafe
Recursive methods require //fusa:recursive <max-depth> annotation
System.out/err usage in non-test code must be flagged unless annotated //fusa:unsafe
Reflection usage requires //fusa:reflect annotation
@SuppressWarnings("unchecked") usage must be flagged unless annotated //fusa:unsafe
@Deprecated API usage must be tracked for migration before certification
SBOM (sbom.json) must be present for supply-chain compliance
Build provenance (provenance.json) must be present for SLSA compliance
Sign.generateKey() must generate and persist a new HMAC-SHA256 key
Sign.sign() must compute and persist an HMAC-SHA256 signature for an artifact
Sign.verify() must validate an artifact's signature against its stored HMAC-SHA256 value
Hara.deriveAsil() must derive an ASIL rating from Severity/Exposure/Controllability per ISO 26262-3 Table 4
Severity.rank() must order INFO < WARNING < ERROR for gate comparisons
Category.jsonValue() must serialize enum constants to their §4 JSON string form
Finding.Builder must support fluent construction of category/standard/clause/remediation before build()
Finding.Builder must support overriding disposition and fingerprint before build()
normalizeMessage() must collapse digit runs and whitespace for stable fingerprinting
Json.Writer must emit well-formed object/array/key structural tokens with correct comma placement
Json.Writer must encode String/long/double/boolean/null scalar values with correct escaping
Json.Writer field()/fieldIfNonBlank() convenience methods must combine key+value and skip blank values
Json.Writer toString()/toPretty()/prettify() must render compact and indented JSON output
Json.parse()/parseObject() must decode a JSON document into plain Java objects
Json.str()/obj()/arr() helpers must extract typed values from a parsed map with safe defaults
Config accessor methods must expose configVersion/version/project/rules/report, with version() aliasing configVersion()
RulesConfig/ReportConfig sub-schemas must support a zero-arg default constructor
Config.save() must persist the §1.2.1 v1.10 schema to .fusa.json
Engine.mustRegister() must delegate registration to the underlying Registry
Engine.rules() must delegate to the underlying Registry and return the sorted rule list
Engine.Result.empty() must return a Result with no findings and no errors
Registry.get() must return the registered rule for a known id, or null when absent
Report.render() must dispatch to the text/json/html/sarif renderer for the requested format
Report.errors()/warnings()/infos() must partition findings by severity
Report.summary() must produce a one-line error/warning/info count summary
Report.categoryBreakdown() must count findings grouped by category
Each format renderer (Text/Json/Html/Sarif) must render a Report into its target format
Qualify.runSelfTests() must produce a fixed suite of TC-* self-test cases with pass/fail results
Qualify.generateReport() 2-arg overload must write qualify-report.json with default (empty) options
Dependency/VulnEntry value types must model a parsed pom.xml dependency and a matched CVE finding
Vuln.parsePom() must extract groupId/artifactId/version from pom.xml <dependency> blocks
Vuln.scan() must parse pom.xml, check known CVEs, and write vuln.json
Vuln.checkKnownVulns() must match dependencies against the known-CVE table by artifactId+version
VULN001 rule must fire when vuln.json is absent and be silent once it is present
ProblemReport.init() must create an empty problem-report log (DO-178C §11.17)
ProblemReport.add() must append a new open problem-report entry
ProblemReport.close() must mark a matching entry closed with its resolution
ProblemReport.load()/save() must round-trip problem-report entries through .fusa-problems.json
ProblemReport.list() must render a tabular summary of logged problem reports
MethodComplexity must record a per-method McCabe cyclomatic complexity measurement
Comp.thresholdForDal() must map DAL-A/B/C/D to their §9.2 complexity thresholds
Comp.analyze() must compute cyclomatic complexity for each method in the project's Java sources
Comp.generate() must write comp-report.json with the §9.2/§3.1 canonical shape, with or without a DAL
COMP001 rule must flag methods whose complexity exceeds the configured threshold
Slsa.buildObjectives() must derive per-level SLSA objective satisfaction status from project evidence
Slsa.generateGapReport() must emit standard='slsa' kind='gap-report' in text or json format
SLSA001 rule must fire when provenance.json is absent and be silent once present
SLSA002 rule must fire when no CODEOWNERS file is present and be silent once present
SLSA003 rule must fire when sbom.json is absent and be silent once present
SafeStateGuard must expose systemId/reason/enteredAt for post-incident diagnosis
Release.generateSBOM() must write sbom.json in x-FuSa SBOM v1 format
Release.generateProvenance() must write provenance.json in x-FuSa provenance v1 format
Release.run()/generateManifest() must produce SBOM+provenance and a SHA-256 artifact manifest
Release.sha256file() must compute a deterministic SHA-256 digest of a file's contents
Iso26262 gap-report command must build, render (text), and write (json) ISO 26262 Part 6 objective status
Iec61508 gap-report command must build, render (text), and write (json) IEC 61508 objective status
Iso21434 gap-report command must build, render (text), and write (json) ISO 21434 objective status
Do178 gap-report command must build, render (text), and write (json) DO-178C table objective status
Unece gap-report command must build, render (text), and write (json) UN R155 threat category coverage
LintRules shared scanner utilities (javaFiles/readLines/loc/hasAnnotation) must underpin every lint rule
Coverage.parse()/CoverageReport must extract statement/branch/method percentages from JaCoCo XML
Badge.generate()/writeToFile() must render a Shields.io-style SVG status badge from a Report
Boundary.buildDependencyGraph()/generate() must derive and render a package dependency graph
Coupling.analyze()/generate() must detect data/control coupling and write coupling-report.json
Hooks.install()/remove() must manage the jfusa-managed git pre-commit hook
Disposition.load()/save()/list() must round-trip and render finding waiver decisions
Fmea.derive()/generate() must derive failure modes from public methods and write fmea.json/csv
Template.generate() must dispatch to the safety-plan/test-evidence/hara/qualification-plan generators
Verify.run() must record default test evidence via saveEvidence()
AuditPack.generate() must bundle evidence artifacts into a hashed audit-pack.zip
Diff.compare()/renderText()/DiffResult.hasIntroduced() must classify findings as introduced/resolved/unchanged between two reports
Hara.defaults()/init()/show() must seed, persist, and render the .fusa-hara.json hazard log
Iec62443.generate() must emit the IEC 62443-4-1 gap-report at a given Security Level
IEC62443-001 rule must fire when INCIDENT-RESPONSE.md is absent and be silent once present
Impact.analyze()/generate() must identify requirements/tests affected by a set of changed files
Metrics.record()/show() must append and render safety-metric history over time
Misra.generate()/scan() must scan Java sources against the MISRA Java 2023 rule subset and write misra-report.json
MISRA001 rule must flag detected MISRA violations as engine findings
Tara.defaultThreats()/generate() must seed and write threat analysis and risk assessment artefacts
SafetyCase.generate() must write the structured safety-case argument (md/json/mermaid)
Sci.generate() must write the Software Configuration Index in json or markdown format
Sas.generate() must write the Software Accomplishment Summary markdown document
Qualify.run()/generateReport() must honor an explicit --output report path and a text/json --format for stdout
Release.run() must honor an explicit --output-dir for sbom.json/provenance.json/artifact-manifest.json, creating it if missing
AuditPack.generate() must honor an explicit --output ZIP path, creating parent directories if missing
AuditPack.generate() must write its own top-level manifest.json (kind: audit-manifest, files[] with path/size/sha256) into the ZIP, distinct from release's artifact-manifest.json
NoConfigException must signal that no .fusa.json configuration file was found
InvalidConfigException must signal that .fusa.json failed to parse or validate
CheckFailedException must signal that one or more safety checks failed (drives EXIT_GATE_FAIL)
Location/Finding records and deriveCategory()/computeFingerprint() must model the §4 finding schema with a prefix-derived category and stable SHA-256 fingerprint
Config.load() must read .fusa.json from the project root, throwing NoConfigException when missing/unreadable and InvalidConfigException on parse failure
Config.parse() must decode both the v1.10 top-level schema and legacy nested project fields (standard/asil/sil/dal) into a Config
Config.validateFormat() must reject report formats other than text/json/html/sarif with InvalidConfigException
Config.defaultConfig() must build a default Config (generic standard, no rule overrides, text report format)
Watchdog must fire its handler if kick() is not called within timeoutMs, for safe-state entry on liveness loss
Heartbeat must invoke its beat handler at a fixed period to signal liveness to an external watchdog
SafeStateGuard must manage an idempotent transition to a defined safe state, running registered onEnter handlers exactly once
SQL injection risk: string concatenation in SQL query (CWE-89)
Command injection risk: process execution with user-controlled data (CWE-78)
Cross-site scripting risk: unescaped output (CWE-79)
Path traversal risk: file path constructed from user input (CWE-22)
Hardcoded password detected (CWE-259)
Hardcoded cryptographic key (CWE-321)
Weak PRNG used for security-sensitive operation (CWE-330)
Weak or obsolete cipher mode (CWE-326)
Broken hash algorithm (CWE-327) — MD5 or SHA-1 used
Cookie created without secure/httpOnly flags (CWE-614)
XML parser without XXE protection (CWE-611)
Insecure deserialization via ObjectInputStream (CWE-502)
Server-side request forgery risk (CWE-918)
Log injection: user input logged without sanitisation (CWE-117)
Potential integer overflow from unsafe narrowing cast (CWE-190)
Exception details leaked to client (CWE-209)
HTTP state-changing action without CSRF token check (CWE-352)
Potentially catastrophic regex — ReDoS risk (CWE-400)
Unbounded resource allocation from user-controlled size (CWE-770)
SECURITY.md must be present (ISO 21434 Ch.10, IEC 62443-4-1)
Potential null dereference — chained call without null check
Resource allocation outside try-with-resources — potential resource leak
Synchronized block on a potentially non-final field — unsafe lock object
InterruptedException caught without re-interrupting — breaks thread lifecycle
Empty catch block silently swallows exceptions
Exception thrown with new message but without chaining cause — losing context
loadReqsMeta parses .fusa-reqs.json with the shared Json parser (correctly handles escaped quotes in title/standard)
